capabilities: Create shortcut notes pointing to the active note via a command
Open shortcuts by redirecting to the target in the same tab
Update shortcut frontmatter when targets are renamed or moved
Detect and safely handle broken, circular, or deeply chained shortcuts
Repair broken shortcuts by editing the symlink property manually
disambiguation: Not a filesystem symlink tool; shortcuts are ordinary Markdown notes with a symlink frontmatter property, and no Node.js or OS symlink APIs are used.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README also documents a release verification process with recorded smoke tests and points to a separate article for design rationale.
motivation: The README explains the rationale for Markdown-level shortcuts rather than filesystem symlinks, pointing to a separate design article.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to place a shortcut note in the vault that opens another note and keeps working when the target is renamed or moved.
summary: Creates portable note shortcuts as ordinary Markdown notes with a symlink property, opening the target note and following target renames and moves.
